note: Plan §8.9 / §4.6 opponent_left variant. The plan's example ('25…Kb6 vs 25…Kxd4') has the moves the wrong way round, and 25…Kxd4 is not legal there (the king is on a7). The fixture uses a legal opponent divergence in the same game: after 24.Rxd4 cxd4 25.Re7+ the engine takes the rook, 25…Qxe7, where Topalov played 25…Kb6. The comparison stops at the opponent's move.
